description: Static guard rules for Reason stage — checked by build-evidence-packet.cjs before LLM rendering. blocker = report MUST say 'unable to give action advice'. warning = allowed but confidence downgraded. info = note only.

rules.description: Portfolio snapshot (S1) missing or failed — cannot recommend any portfolio action
rules.message: 持仓数据缺失，无法给出任何组合行动建议，需人工确认持仓状态后判断。

rules.description: Critical core indicator (B2 US 10Y, F2 PCE, G4 COMEX gold, etc.) is staleGap — cannot make strong directional claims
rules.message: 核心指标 {indicators} 数据过期（staleGap），当前无法给出强方向性结论，需等待数据更新。

rules.status_note: Enforced at B-layer (LLM blueprint guard), not in A-layer builder — no MMF/cash claim detection in CJS
rules.description: Money market fund holdings counted as 'cash position' — prohibited. MMF is a fund holding, not cash.
rules.message: 报告中不得将货币基金归类为现金。货基是基金持仓而非现金等价物，只有活期宝可以视为类现金。

rules.status_note: Enforced at B-layer (LLM blueprint guard) — no backtest-origin detection in A-layer CJS
rules.description: Backtest returns presented as real account returns — prohibited
rules.message: 报告中不得将回测收益作为真实收益呈现。回测≠实盘，必须区分来源后呈现。

rules.status_note: Enforced at B-layer (LLM blueprint guard) — A-layer passes action_advice_allowed but single-indicator trade logic is in blueprint
rules.description: Trading recommendation based on a single indicator change — insufficient evidence
rules.message: 单一指标变化不足以支撑交易建议。所有行动建议必须基于因果链分析（≥2个独立信号源互相印证）。

rules.status_note: Enforced at B-layer (LLM blueprint guard) — portfolio source provenance checked in blueprint, not CJS
rules.description: Current holdings inferred from memory instead of portfolio-snapshot
rules.message: 当前持仓必须从 portfolio-snapshot 读取，不得依赖 memory 推断。memory 可能过期。

rules.status_note: Enforced at B-layer (LLM blueprint guard) — evidence source tracking present in packet but news detection is semantic, not mechanical
rules.description: News article price used as indicator value — prohibited. Must use indicator source (ttfund/iFinD/Wind/WebSearch).
rules.message: 报告中不得使用新闻文章中的价格替代指标数据。所有精确值必须标明指标来源。

rules.description: Non-critical auxiliary indicator is staleGap — confidence downgrade
rules.message: 辅助指标 {indicators} 数据过期（staleGap），相关分析的置信度已降低。

rules.description: Portfolio data partially available (e.g., S2 empty, S3 unavailable) — confidence downgrade
rules.message: 组合收益/分析数据部分缺失，基于组合的分析置信度已降低。

rules.status_note: A-layer tracks source per indicator in evidence entries; semantic secondary-source judgment (e.g. WebSearch for a core indicator) left to B-layer blueprint
rules.description: Evidence uses non-primary source (e.g., WebSearch instead of iFinD for critical indicator)
rules.message: 部分证据使用了非主数据源（WebSearch 补采），其值可能与主源存在口径差异。

rules.description: Data from previous trading day on weekend/Monday — normal lag
rules.message: 部分数据为上交易日数据（周末/周一正常滞后），非数据源异常。

rules.status_note: Cross-source comparison logic not implemented in A-layer; B-layer may flag discrepancies when same indicator appears from multiple sources
rules.description: Same indicator has different values from different sources — note the discrepancy
rules.message: 以下指标在不同数据源之间存在口径差异：{discrepancies}。报告中已标注具体来源。
